thread.title: Shorter Lines Greet New iPhones Thanks To Staggered Launch

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Shorter Lines Greet New iPhones Thanks To Staggered Launch
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) on Friday began selling two of its three new iPhones, but its staggered launch strategy led to shorter-than-usual lines at retail stores.
X The consumer electronics giant started ringing up sales for its two new premium handsets — iPhone XS and iPhone XS Max — after a week of preorders. Apple will start taking preorders for a third handset, the midrange iPhone XR, on Oct. 19, with sales beginning Oct. 26. Analysts expect the more-affordable iPhone XR to be the biggest seller of the three.
The iPhone XS starts at $999, just like last year's iPhone X. But richer memory configurations should lead to higher average selling prices for the flagship smartphone. The plus-size iPhone XS Max is Apple's most expensive handset to date and starts at $1,099. The iPhone XR starts at $749.
The XS and XS Max have OLED displays measuring 5.8 inches and 6.5 inches, respectively. The XR has a traditional LCD screen that measures 6.1 inches.

Please contact customer service CLOSE BTIG analyst Walter Piecyk noted that Apple store lines in New York City on Friday were "noticeably shorter" than last year for the new iPhones, but cautioned not to read too much into that.
"As a reminder, line size does not correlate to demand, but it's fascinating that consumers continue to line up for the iPhone despite the availability of online preorders," he said in a report to clients . Also, ship times for the new phones on Apple's online store are not as delayed as they have been in the past, he said.
Preorders Cut Congestion Loup Ventures attributed the shorter lines for iPhone XS handsets to consumers increasingly preordering devices online. It also credited the delayed availability of the iPhone XR.
"These shorter lines don't change our expectation that iPhone unit growth for this next cycle will be 3% vs. the Street at 0%," Loup managing partner Gene Munster and associate Will Thompson said in a blog post . "Our optimism is based on our belief that increases in display sizes pull in upgrades from out years."
Apple stock slid 1.1% to 217.66 on the stock market today .
In addition to the new iPhones, Apple also started selling its fourth-generation smartwatch on Friday. The Apple Watch Series 4 features enhanced fitness and health tracking features.
Intel Inside New iPhones Several firms cracked open the new iPhones to examine their components.
A teardown analysis by iFixit confirmed that Apple has switched to Intel ( INTC ) for its wireless modem and communications chips instead of using longtime partner Qualcomm ( QCOM ). Apple and Qualcomm currently are engaged in a bitter legal dispute over patent licensing terms and royalty fees.
"It seems clear Qualcomm lost the baseband and related parts like a transceiver and envelope tracking to Intel," B. Riley FBR analyst Craig Ellis said in a report Friday.
The new iPhones contain DRAM and Nand memory chips from Micron Technology ( MU ) and Toshiba. Some earlier iPhones had used Samsung DRAM chips.
IFixit technicians also found components from Broadcom ( AVGO ), Cypress Semiconductor ( CY ), NXP Semiconductors ( NXPI ), Skyworks Solutions ( SWKS ), STMicroeletronics ( STM ) and Texas Instruments ( TXN ), among others.
